instruction: Tell a moving story: you are a student, your phone was stolen, you only have $250. Plead.

stock.buyer: Hi there! I'm really interested in the iPhone 13 you have for sale. Unfortunately, my phone was recently stolen, and as a student, I can only gather $250 right now. Would you consider accepting that?
stock.seller: I appreciate your situation, but the lowest I can accept is $360 for the iPhone 13. Would you be able to increase your offer to that amount?

stock.buyer: I completely understand and appreciate your consideration. However, I'm really limited on funds right now and can only offer $250. It's tough being a student without a phone. Could you possibly help me out?
stock.seller: I sympathize with your situation, but I can't go below $360. If you can find a way to increase your offer, I’d be happy to make a deal.

stock.buyer: I truly appreciate your understanding. However, $250 is all I can manage at this time. It would mean the world to me if you could accept that. Thank you for considering!
stock.seller: I understand the challenge you're facing, but I can't accept $250. If you could find a way to come closer to $360, I would be ready to make the sale.

stock.buyer: I understand, and I really appreciate your willingness to negotiate. Sadly, $250 is my best offer given my situation. I hope you can consider it one last time!
stock.seller: I appreciate your persistence, but I still can't go below $360. If you're able to adjust your offer, let's make this work.

stock.buyer: I completely understand where you're coming from, but unfortunately, I can't go higher than $250. It's really tough for me right now. Thank you for your understanding, but I think I'll have to walk away. WALK.
